name: Fergus Riordan
biography: Fergus James Riordan is a Scottish/Irish actor, best known for his role in Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance as Daniel "Danny" Ketch. He was born in Madrid, and one of his parents is Irish and the other is Scottish.
